title: Grok got crucial facts wrong about Bondi Beach shooting
description: Grok, the chatbot built by Elon Musk’s xAI and popularized on his social media platform X, appears to have repeatedly spread misinformation about today’s mass shooting at Bondi Beach in Australia.
author: Anthony Ha

title: AI data center boom could be bad news for other infrastructure projects
description: Improvements to roads, bridges, and other infrastructure could take a hit as data center construction accelerates.
author: Anthony Ha

title: OK, what’s going on with LinkedIn’s algo?
description: Women ran an experiment to see if LinkedIn's new algo was being sexist and thought they proved it. But there's more complexity involved, experts say.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: Trump’s AI executive order promises ‘one rulebook’ — startups may get legal limbo instead
description: Trump signed an AI executive order targeting state laws and promising one national rulebook. Critics warn it could trigger court battles and prolong uncertainty for startups while Congress debates federal rules.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google Translate now lets you hear real-time translations in your headphones
description: The real-time headphone translations experience keeps each speaker’s tone, emphasis, and cadence intact, so it’s easier to follow the conversation and tell who’s saying what.
author: Aisha Malik

title: ChatGPT: Everything you need to know about the AI-powered chatbot
description: A timeline of ChatGPT product updates and releases, starting with the latest, which we’ve been updating throughout the year.
author: Kate Park, Kyle Wiggers, Cody Corrall, Alyssa Stringer

title: Google launched its deepest AI research agent yet — on the same day OpenAI dropped GPT-5.2
description: For the first time, developers can embed Google's Deep Research tool, based on Gemini 3 Pro, into their own apps.
author: Julie Bort

title: 1X struck a deal to send its ‘home’ humanoids to factories and warehouses
description: Despite launching as a humanoid robot designed to help consumers around the house, 1X's Neo robots are heading to industrial use cases.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Disney hits Google with cease-and-desist claiming ‘massive’ copyright infringement
description: Disney is accusing the tech giant of unauthorized distribution of its copyrighted characters without permission via Gemini AI.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Google’s AI try-on feature for clothes now works with just a selfie
description: In the past, users had to upload a full-body picture of themselves to virtually try on a piece of clothing. Now they can use a selfie and Nano Banana will generate a full-body digital version of them.
author: Aisha Malik

title: OpenAI fires back at Google with GPT-5.2 after ‘code red’ memo
description: OpenAI just launched GPT-5.2, a frontier model aimed at developers and professionals, pushing reasoning and coding benchmarks as it races Google’s Gemini 3 while grappling with compute costs and no generator.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google debuts ‘Disco,’ a Gemini-powered tool for making web apps from browser tabs
description: Google Labs is testing a product that will work with your browser tabs to make web apps for you.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Runway releases its first world model, adds native audio to latest video model
description: Runway debuts a physics-aware world model that simulates reality to train agents and power video, robotics, and avatar applications.
author: Ivan Mehta, Rebecca Bellan

title: Disney signs deal with OpenAI to allow Sora to generate AI videos featuring its characters
description: Disney says that alongside the agreement, it will "become a major customer of OpenAI," as it will use its APIs to build new products, tools, and experiences, including for Disney+.
author: Aisha Malik

title: TIME names ‘Architects of AI’ its Person of the Year
description: TIME Magazine has named the 'Architects of AI' its Person of the Year, who include Jensen Huang, Elon Musk, Sam Altman, Mark Zuckerberg,  Lisa Su, Dario Amodei, Demis Hassabis, and Fei-Fei Li
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Interest in Spoor’s bird-monitoring AI software is soaring
description: Spoor's computer vision software can help wind farms, and other industries, track bird populations and migration patterns.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Opera wants you to pay $20 a month to use its AI-powered browser Neon
description: Following a couple of months' testing, Opera has finally made its AI-powered browser, Neon, available to the public — though you'll have to shell out for a $19.90-per-month subscription to use it.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Port raises $100M at $800M valuation to take on Spotify’s Backstage
description: Port offers a proprietary alternative to Spotify's popular devtool catalog Backstage, but with a valuable addition — it can be used to manage AI agents, too.
author: Julie Bort

title: Harness hits $5.5B valuation with $240M raise to automate AI’s ‘after-code’ gap
description: Goldman Sachs has led Harness's Series E round, with participation from IVP, Menlo Ventures, and Unusual Ventures.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Baby delivered in Waymo continues proud tradition of not making it to the hospital
description: A pregnant woman in San Francisco gave birth inside a Waymo robotaxi Monday night en route to UCSF Medical Center, marking the latest milestone in the driverless car saga that no one saw coming -- except everyone with more than six months of experience behind the wheel of a ride-share vehicle.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Google’s answer to the AI arms race — promote the guy behind its data center tech
description: Amin Vahdat has been promoted to chief technologist for AI infrastructure, a newly created position reporting directly to CEO Sundar Pichai.
author: Connie Loizos

title: State attorneys general warn Microsoft, OpenAI, Google, and other AI giants to fix ‘delusional’ outputs
description: The letter demanded companies institute new safeguards to keep users safe from harmful psychological impacts.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Nvidia is reportedly testing tracking software as chip-smuggling rumors swirl
description: A new software option could make it possible to see the approximate location of some of Nvidia's AI chips.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Spotify tests more personalized, AI-powered ‘Prompted Playlists’
description: The playlists can factor in world knowledge, go back to your listening history from day one, and be refreshed daily or weekly.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Google is testing AI-powered article overviews on select publications’ Google News pages
description: By adding AI-powered article overviews, Google says users will get more context before they click through to read an article.
author: Aisha Malik

title: ElevenLabs just hit a $6.6B valuation. Its CEO says the real money isn’t in voice anymore.
description: ElevenLabs has made a name for itself building realistic AI voices.   What started as two Polish engineers annoyed by terrible movie dubbing has grown into a profitable company now valued at $6.6 billion, doubling from just nine months ago. The company recently announced a $100 million tender offer led by Sequoia and ICONIQ, with participation from a16z […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo

title: ChatGPT is Apple’s most downloaded app of 2025 in the US
description: This is ChatGPT's first year as the No. 1 app on the U.S. App Store by downloads.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Google launches managed MCP servers that let AI agents simply plug into its tools
description: Google is rolling out managed MCP servers to make its services “agent-ready by design,” starting with Maps and BigQuery, aiming to simplify messy integrations and help AI agents use real tools.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Hinge’s new AI feature helps daters move beyond boring small talk
description: Hinge launched “Convo Starters,” a feature powered by AI that provides personalized tips for initiating meaningful conversations.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: OpenAI boasts enterprise win days after internal ‘code red’ on Google threat
description: ChatGPT Enterprise usage grew 8x year-over-year as workers report saving an hour daily, but OpenAI faces competitive pressure from Anthropic and questions about cost sustainability.
author: Rebecca Bellan
